title: the tree tool's proof reaches no codemother code: orient's teeth move beside orient
intention: The four teeth in cairn/tools/tree/proofs/test_chart_tree.py that drive orient's deposit_orient and validate_orient move, unchanged, to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/orient/proofs/test_orient_deposits_into_the_tree.py, beside the code they measure; the tree tool's proof imports nothing from codemother.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-encapsulation-holds naming cairn/tools/tree/proofs/test_chart_tree.py:50, :225 and :364 importing cairn.devices.codemother.machines.orient.orient from the tree tool. RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only that component.
how: Lift test_gate_before_seed, test_deposit_back_lands_and_dedups, test_the_orient_leaf_is_codemothers_scratch, test_tree_is_a_legal_stratum_at_the_packet_gate and their helpers (_orient_nexus, _orient_table, _refuses, _packet, _berthed_fixture) out of cairn/tools/tree/proofs/test_chart_tree.py into cairn/devices/codemother/machines/orient/proofs/test_orient_deposits_into_the_tree.py with their PROVES keys (9c46e187f2de, a229f01ed699); add one tooth asking the encapsulation_holds sieve for component tree. No production code.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds sieve returns [] for component tree at cairn/tools/tree

the moved orient teeth (gate before seed, deposit-back, codemother's scratch leaf, 'tree' a legal stratum at the packet gate) stand green at cairn/devices/codemother/machines/orient/proofs/test_orient_deposits_into_the_tree.py

decisions.text: D1: the four teeth and five helpers move with their text unchanged; the new file mints its own codemother-owned scratch nexus and drops it at close; cairn/tools/tree/proofs/test_chart_tree.py keeps every other tooth and loses its orient import, its orient PROVES keys and its two orient docstring bullets.
